item.title: Post-quantum account type with a published migration deadline
item.body:
A second signature type, ML-DSA-44, as a NoM account type, with a key migration signed by
both keys and a published deadline (roadmap M10).

- ML-DSA-44 account type: a 2,420-byte signature and a 1,312-byte key fit the 16 KB block
- Migration transaction signed by the Ed25519 and ML-DSA keys
- SDK and wallet support: znn_sdk_dart, znn.ts, Syrius, the extension
item.author: dev-ada
